Visitor removes all buttons from output

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

type testVisitorVisitorButtonSkip struct{
	htmd.BaseVisitor
}
func (v *testVisitorVisitorButtonSkip) VisitButton(ctx htmd.NodeContext, text string) htmd.VisitResult {
	return htmd.VisitResultSkip()
}

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{}
	visitor := &testVisitorVisitorButtonSkip{}
	options.Visitor = visitor
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<p>Actions available: <button>Save</button> <button>Delete</button> <button>Export</button></p>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result)
}
```
